title: Market events — 2026-11-24
body:
**Dell Q3 FY27 — today (Tue 2026-11-24), results after US close (~16:00 ET / 22:00 Berlin; call 16:30 ET / 22:30 Berlin).** Consensus: revenue ~$49–50B, adjusted EPS ~$6.60–6.75; watch the $95B AI-server backlog and FY27 guidance. Options imply a ~±12.7% move. Dell is the cleanest public read on AI-server orders that underpin datacenter power demand: a backlog beat supports the power/utilities sleeve (CEG, NRG, DUK); a miss undercuts the infrastructure leg and argues for holding the 15% cash sleeve.

**October PCE — Wed 2026-11-25, 08:30 ET / 14:30 Berlin.** The week's key print with a Dec 9 hike expected: hot core hits semis and multiple-heavy AI names first; a cool print is the relief valve for the whole chain.

Context: Monday's NVDA +31.5% (2026-11-23) was a CEO-reinstatement event, not an earnings reaction — no chain company reported in the last 24h.
